findings.body: This previously reported defect remains unresolved. Git's [porcelain -z format](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-status) represents a staged rename as `R  new.txt\0old.txt\0`. Removing three characters from every NUL-separated field produces `new.txt` and `.txt`, corrupting the source path. A resumed upgrade passes these paths to `repo.commit_state` at src/forge/upgrade.py:150; the `git add` at src/forge/repo.py:464 then fails on the nonexistent path, preventing the upgrade from committing and closing. Disable rename detection for this listing or parse the second filename explicitly.
findings.title: Parse both filenames in staged rename records
